data.JobDescription:
Job Context

Provide on-site software support to customers, assist with day-to-day software operations, and support bill collection and software sales activities.

Job Location: Dhaka (travel outside Dhaka may be required)

Job Responsibilities

  • Visit customer premises to provide software support and resolve basic technical issues.

  • Assist customers in using ERP, accounting, inventory, POS, and other business software.

  • Install and configure software and provide user training as required.

  • Collect monthly and annual software fees and follow up on outstanding payments.

  • Assist customers with daily software operations and coordinate with the technical team to resolve complex issues.

  • Support software sales activities and maintain accurate records of customer visits and payment collections.
data.EducationRequirements: • Diploma in Computer in Computer Science & Engineering
data.SkillsRequired: Accounting Software, ERP Software, IT Support Service, Software Implementation
data.SuggestedSkills: IT & Software Marketing, ERP Systems, Software Development
data.AdditionJobRequirements:
• Age 18 to 30 years
  • Only Male
  • Freshers are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience in software support or customer service will be an advantage.
  • Basic computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Willingness to travel within and outside Dhaka for customer visits.
data.CompanyBusiness:
A leading software company in Bangladesh specializing in inventory, accounting, HR & Payroll, CRM, and enterprise solutions for businesses of all sizes since 2003.
3500+Clients Across Bangladesh and Beyond Singapore, Saudi Arabia, UAE & USA trust our software solutions.Streamline Your Operations.

* Web, Desktop, and Mobile Application Development
* Custom Software Development and Prototyping with Quality Assurance
* Testing, Deployment, and Implementation
* Web API Integration and Cloud Computing
* System Maintenance and Upgrades existing systems
* Data Encryption for Security
* Follow-up and Technical Support, Including User Training
data.CompanyAddress: Suite # 4C-4D, Star Palace (4th Floor), 66-67 Elephant Road, Dhaka-1205
data.JobOtherBenifits: Mobile phone allowance. Reimbursement of transportation expenses for official field visits. Collection commission as per company policy. Sales commission as per company policy.
